doc.brief: The QGraphicsSceneDragDropEvent class provides events for drag and drop in the graphics view framework.
doc.index_brief: Events for drag and drop in the graphics view framework

QPoint screenPos() const.brief: Returns the position of the mouse relative to the screen.

QPointF pos() const.brief: Returns the mouse position of the event relative to the view that sent the event.

QPointF scenePos() const.brief: Returns the position of the mouse in scene coordinates.

QWidget * source() const.brief: This function returns the [QGraphicsView](xref:qt:QGraphicsView) that created the [QGraphicsSceneDragDropEvent](xref:qt:QGraphicsSceneDragDropEvent).

Qt::DropAction dropAction() const.brief: Returns the action that was performed in this drag and drop.

Qt::DropAction proposedAction() const.brief: Returns the drop action that is proposed, i.e., preferred.

Qt::DropActions possibleActions() const.brief: Returns the possible drop actions that the drag and drop can result in.

Qt::KeyboardModifiers modifiers() const.brief: Returns the keyboard modifiers that were pressed when the drag and drop event was created.

Qt::MouseButtons buttons() const.brief: Returns a [Qt::MouseButtons](https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/qt.html#MouseButton-enum) value indicating which buttons were pressed on the mouse when this mouse event was generated.

const QMimeData * mimeData() const.brief: This function returns the MIME data of the event.

void acceptProposedAction().brief: Sets the proposed action as accepted, i.e, the drop action is set to the proposed action.

void setDropAction(Qt::DropAction action.brief: This function lets the receiver of the drop set the drop action that was performed to *action*, which should be one of the [possible actions](xref:qt:QGraphicsSceneDragDropEvent).
